name: Revenge Death Ball
findings: Parallel Quest 127 — Multiverse Match of the Century
300 Ki consumed on input even while charging
Minimum charge: 12 hits and approximately 30% damage
Maximum charge: 22 hits and approximately 70% damage
Remaining Ki can be charged into the attack; cited timing is about 10 seconds from 300 Ki and 3 seconds from maximum Ki
Red-health acceleration is documented without a normalized multiplier
Exact frame data and reward probability remain unresolved
